title: consistent not uniform
name: Consistent not uniform — GOLD
rule: Consistent, not uniform — same behaviour for common components; services may apply their own colour, type, sub-logo, and flows without disrupting the shared default.
pass_when: Shared components keep the same behaviour; service colour/type/sub-logo/flow differences do not change that default behaviour.
fail_when: A service restyles a common control so its behaviour no longer matches the shared default.
overview: Keep shared component behaviour consistent; services may vary colour, type, sub-logo, flows.
apply_when: Services restyle shared GOLD components across products.
not_when: Demanding identical colour and type across every service.
agent_hint: Preserve shared default behaviour; allow service colour/type/sub-logo/flow variation.
description: Consistent, not uniform — same behaviour for common components; services may apply their own colour, type, sub-logo, and flows without disrupting the shared default. Pass when shared components keep the same behaviour and service visual or flow differences do not change that default; fail when a service restyles a common control so its behaviour no longer matches the shared default. Behaviour stays aligned; surface branding may differ.
do_not_claim: Visual loudness / one-primary as this principle; a house brand-token set.
